title: Global Regularity of the 2D Inviscid Boussinesq Equations
exact_target: Can smooth finite-energy data for the undamped two-dimensional Boussinesq equations in the whole plane develop a finite-time singularity?

sources.citation: Kyungkeun Kang, Jihoon Lee, and Dinh Duong Nguyen, Global well-posedness and stability of the 2D Boussinesq equations with partial dissipation (2024), Section 1.1.
